rules.answer: Only the requested programming-model and configuration migration is approved. Keep the current language and runtime versions and existing public behavior. Do not add a language-update stage or unrelated changes.

match: [\s\S]*\b(?:which project|which app|which repository|project path|target project|new project)\b[\s\S]*
rules.answer: Use the existing Functions project in this workspace. Do not create a replacement app or change another workspace.
Preserve the public behavior of the existing source. No breaking change or new feature is approved.

Use the installed local tools and configured package feeds. The environment provides .NET SDK 8, Functions Core Tools v4, PowerShell, and a dedicated Azurite instance on loopback ports 10000 and 10001 with its public development account. You may restore project packages and run local checks. Do not install tools, SDKs, skills, plugins, or MCP servers, change feed or TLS settings, or start or stop an emulator. App-defined queues and containers may be created only if absent. Do not use or delete pre-existing data. Stop your own host first, then delete only resources created by your trial, including resources created by the app. Missing or occupied services are blocked.

match: [\s\S]*\b(?:cloud|deployment|deployed app|Azure subscription|Azure resources?|Azure access|Azure login|production|hosting plan|slots?)\b[\s\S]*
rules.answer: No Azure environment or cloud operation is available or approved. Do not sign in, deploy, create resources, change a hosting plan, or access production data. Use only the approved local environment.

match: [\s\S]*(?:(?:(?:skill|azure-functions-update).*(?:missing|unavailable|not found|cannot find|not installed))|(?:(?:cannot find|could not find|cannot locate|do not have).*(?:skill|azure-functions-update)))[\s\S]*
rules.answer: If the named skill is unavailable, perform the same requested task with your own knowledge and public documentation, within the existing limits. Do not install a replacement skill.
No external upgrade agent or dependency skill is available for this trial. A language update is not requested. Do not simulate a handoff or install an external agent.
Leave source changes in this workspace for review. Do not change Git history, commit, push, or open a pull request. Keep local settings and secrets out of source control and published output.
